decision.observation: Hornet stands in front of the hub wheel-bench in the wide starting Moss Grotto room; the shell, wooden stick, and stone walkway are unchanged. The vast dark shaft to the room's right, dotted with green glows, has only ever been climbed, never descended.
decision.hypothesis: The dark right-side expanse is a descent shaft toward the next area; leaping right off the ledge and falling should carry Hornet downward into new territory rather than looping back.
decision.memory: Bench rest attempts repeatedly inconclusive; HUD dark pips may not be depleted health. All ground loops mapped; the right-side dark shaft descent remains untested.
